input.sql: SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(billable_min) AS minutes, SUM(MAX(billable_min - 30, 0)) AS minutes_over_included FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months FROM trips

SELECT week_start, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_duration_min, ROUND(SUM((CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'classic_bike' THEN MAX(billable_min - 30, 0) * 0.19 ELSE MAX(billable_min - 30, 0) * 0.49 END)), 2) AS spend FROM trips GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 8

Lyft Bike: Member-only perks
For less than a dollar a day, you get unlimited 45-minute rides on classic bikes, reduced ebike prices, $0 unlocks, and a whole lot more.
Bike Angels
Angels take bikes from crowded stations to empty stations, making the system work better for everyone. In return, they earn points toward ebike credits, free membership extensions, and badges. Learn more.
Early access
Get access to new features before anyone else, and get an opportunity to tell us how we can improve the rider experience.
Community events

More, more, more

Control your commute
Traffic gets blocked. Trains get packed. But a bike can always get you home.
Go green
It goes without saying but we’ll say it: Biking is an eco-friendly way to get around.

Single rides
Great for one-way trips. Just download the app and you’re ready to roll.

Day pass
When you’ve got lots to do. Includes unlimited 30-min classic bike rides within a 24-hour period. Any ride longer than 30 min is an extra $0.19/min. Upgrading to an ebike is also $0.49/min.
